people.name: Bethlehem

people.name: Rachel
people.line: Wife of Jacob; mother of Joseph and Benjamin

translations.web: Rachel died, and was buried on the way to Ephrath (also called Bethlehem).
translations.bsb: So Rachel died and was buried on the way to Ephrath (that is, Bethlehem).
translations.kjv: And Rachel died, and was buried in the way to Ephrath, which is Bethlehem.
translations.asv: And Rachel died, and was buried in the way to Ephrath (the same is Beth-lehem).
